title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Say what was good
hook: How many times did you say good job at practice?
intro: Good job. Good job. Nice job.
statement: Specific praise tells a kid what to do again.
q1: Do you name exactly what went well —
q2: or keep praise quick so the drill keeps moving?
q3: What did that player do well, exactly?
t1: Every coach is different. But praise teaches
t2: when it names what the player did.
ctaLines: Great glove work. Nice throw to the bag. Good call for the ball.
ctaPrompt: Share your praise habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How many times did you say good job at practice?
Good job. Good job. Nice job. Kids stop hearing it.
Specific praise tells a kid what to do again.
Specific praise or quick praise. There is no perfect answer.
How do you praise? Share your habit in the comments.
